title: Bill Sienkiewicz
description: "Seeing STAR WARS for the first time was an incredible experience," recalls Bill Sienkiewicz. "This cutaway view of Darth Vader suggests THE MAN IN THE IRON MASK to me... a human being forever trapped in his own personal dungeon." A comics professional since 1978, Sienkiewicz also designs and illustrates magazines and record albums. Comics credits include FANTASTIC FOUR, ELECTRA: ASSASSIN, MOON KNIGHT, STRAY TOASTERS, MOBY DICK and his most recent project for Random House: VOODOO CHILD, a visual biography of Jimi Hendrix.
